title: Volume 1 Chapter 8: The Potential of Non-Attribute 1
content: Several days had passed since we saved the village.
Krush and I returned safely to the Knight Order's headquarters and headed straight to Lady Rana's office.
I would like to report that the issue regarding the village away from the Royal Capital Corias, which was an Adventurers Guild request, has been resolved.
I bowed deeply before Lady Rana, whom I hadn’t seen in a few days.
Krush quietly bowed beside me. Lady Rana smiled gently at us.
"You did well, Lord Salt. And you too, Krush... I'm just glad you're both safe."
Thank you.
In this incident, the miasma caused a deadly illness to spread among the villagers, and it seems that nearby orcs and goblins had transformed into zombies.
If we had left it as it was, the dead might have turned into zombies.
I purified the area around the village and the forest using Holy Attribute magic.
After reporting, Lady Rana frowned slightly and then asked me.
Miasma, huh?
I've experienced it myself, and there have been numerous damage reports.
If we don't eliminate the root cause, we won't be able to resolve this dangerous situation.
"Yes. However, with the cooperation of Krush and the villagers, we managed to overcome it somehow."
I sensed that Krush seemed a bit unsettled by my words.
She still looked tired, and her expression was anxious.
"I see... Thank you for your hard work."
Lady Rana returned to her soft expression and praised us.
However, I noticed that despite her words, Krush's expression remained somewhat downcast.
"Krush, are you okay? You look tired."
Krush looked at me in surprise for a moment but quickly smiled and shook her head.
"I'm fine. It's just... I have a few things on my mind."
"Is something bothering you?"
When Lady Rana asked, Krush answered while looking down.
Seeing the villagers grateful to Lord Salt made me feel an emotion I couldn't understand.
I know everyone is thankful and respects Lord Salt.
But...
I don't understand what 'love' is.
Lady Rana showed a puzzled expression at Krush's report. However, I didn't feel pessimistic about her words.
"Krush, you were gently stroking the sisters' heads when they were protected, weren't you?"
"Was I?"
"Yeah. What did you think about them?"
"Um? I just wanted to express my gratitude for their help and praise the courage of the weak trying to protect them."
"I think that too is 'love.'"
"Huh?"
The kindness and caring heart you have for them, as well as the feelings of praising their courage, all of that can be seen as love.
"Is this 'love'?"
She sometimes seems to express her emotions modestly and keeps a distance from others' feelings.
"I was raised as an orphan and feel indebted to Lady Rana and Lady Freina. But... I don't know if that is love."
"Krush, by interacting with many people alongside Lord Salt, you might come to understand 'love.'"
"I will come to know 'love'?"
Yes.
Krush, didn't you want to know love?
The fact that you are questioning it shows you have an interest.
I'm glad you've started to think about 'love.' It's okay if you don't understand it now.
I look forward to the day you can tell me when you do.
Lady Rana spoke to Krush as if to embrace her heart.
That's something I couldn't do, but I thought it was good for Krush to think about 'love' through Lady Rana's words.
I still don't really understand.
But I don't dislike learning alongside Lord Salt.
So, I want to continue to act as Lord Salt's personal guard and learn those feelings.
Hearing Krush's words, I felt that she was beginning to change little by little.
Rather than forcing herself to understand, she was trying to take her time to learn that emotion.
"I understand, Krush. Let's keep doing our best together."
When I said that, Krush nodded slightly and smiled a little.
Lady Rana watched this exchange with a smile. Then, she said:
Lord Salt, please continue to look after Krush.
She will learn a lot from you.
And...
Krush, you too should open your heart to Lord Salt and learn much from him.
"Yes! Lady Rana! I will rely on you, Lord Salt."
"Yeah, I look forward to it, Krush."
We nodded deeply at Lady Rana's words.
Renewing our resolve to walk together from now on, we took our leave from Lady Rana.
Thanks to Lady Rana's words, Krush decided not to overthink 'love' but to gradually understand it while learning alongside me.
This resolved one of the worries she had, and she began to approach training with a brighter expression than before.
I felt a bit relieved watching her and wanted to see how Krush would change from now on.
After returning from the expedition, I headed to Lady Rana's examination.
Upon entering the office, I found Lady Rana sitting elegantly in a chair, sipping tea.
When she noticed me, she smiled and welcomed me.
Lord Salt, is it time for your examination?
Thank you as always.
I also appreciate you helping Krush resolve her worries.
"No, I think she overcame her worries on her own."
Even so, I believe it was because you were there that Krush could resolve her issues.
I truly appreciate it.
She will gradually change, just like I did.
"I think it's thanks to Lady Rana's advice. I was just by her side."
Lady Rana nodded quietly, looking at me with warm eyes.
In her gaze, I no longer felt the fear or distance I had sensed before; instead, I felt a sense of trust and reassurance.
"Still, it was significant that you were there for Krush. Please continue to support her."
"Of course. Krush is my personal knight, so I would be happy to support her."
After finishing Lady Rana's examination, I headed to the Adventurers Guild to report.
Upon arriving at the guild, I approached the reception as usual and requested a meeting with the vice guild master.
The vice guild master appeared immediately and guided me to a meeting room within the guild.
Once inside, the vice guild master sat down and spoke to me with a serious expression.
Lord Salt, thank you for your report.
We have confirmed the purification of the miasma in the village.
However, we have also obtained new information.
We may have found the root cause of the miasma.
"Really?"
I was surprised and filled with anticipation. I had no idea what caused the miasma that attacked that village.
The miasma is a significant threat to this world. If we could identify its cause, we might be able to save many lives.
It's not confirmed yet, but similar miasma has been observed in several areas.
And we found that all of it is emanating from the same direction.
"The same direction?"
"Yes. It seems that the miasma is descending from the rocky mountains on the outskirts of Corias Territory."
"The rocky mountains?"
I recalled the rocky mountains I had seen near that village.
Indeed, that area had little forest, and the vegetation and soil were devastated.
I nodded, surprised yet convinced by the information.
If the villagers were attacked and a deadly illness spread due to the miasma, and if it was indeed spreading from the top of the rocky mountains, we needed to pinpoint the cause.
"Will you be requesting us to investigate the source of the miasma?"
The vice guild master nodded and spread out a map, indicating the location of the rocky mountains.
Yes.
A dragon zombie has been confirmed near the summit of the rocky mountains on the outskirts of Corias Territory.
It seems that the miasma is coming from there.
With your Holy Attribute power, you should be able to purify the miasma as you advance.
If the dragon zombie is indeed the source of the miasma, defeating it may eliminate the cause threatening the entire territory.
I nodded without hesitation at that proposal.
"Understood. I will head out with Krush to investigate."
The vice guild master smiled with satisfaction at my decision.
"I have high expectations. I'm sure you will solve this."
Having formally accepted the request to defeat the dragon zombie, I returned to the Knight Order's headquarters to report to Lady Rana.
Upon entering Lady Rana's office, it seemed that documents from the Adventurers Guild had arrived for her.
Freina was also standing by, seemingly in the midst of a report.
"Lady Rana, Lady Freina, I have a report."
As I quietly called out, the two looked up and turned to me.
"What is it, Lord Salt?"
Lady Rana asked gently.
I bowed deeply and explained that I had accepted the request to defeat the dragon zombie, along with the details.
According to the Adventurers Guild, the dragon's corpse left abandoned in the northern mountains has become a zombie due to the miasma, and it could affect the surrounding villages.
I will head out to investigate.
The two widened their eyes in surprise for a moment, then fell silent, deep in thought.
Freina looked at us with a serious expression.
"A dragon zombie, huh? It won't be an easy opponent. Isn't it a bit reckless for you to handle this alone, Lord Salt?"
Freina's concern was valid.
That may be true.
However, I believe I can deal with the dragon zombie, which is of the death attribute, since I have the Holy Attribute.
Holy Attribute magic is effective against miasma.
When I confidently answered, Freina opened her mouth.
Indeed, with your Holy Attribute magic, you should be able to purify the miasma.
However, the dragon zombie is a formidable opponent.
There's also the risk of other monsters gathering.
That's why I would like to request the Fourth Knight Order's cooperation.
I want them to send aid to the village that suffered from this incident and help clear out nearby monsters.
Additionally, I would like Krush to accompany me as a support to fight the dragon zombie.
If I fail, I would like the surrounding villagers to be evacuated as needed.
Lady Rana fell silent for a moment before letting out a deep sigh.
Understood.
Lord Salt, I trust your judgment.
However, please do not push yourself.
If you feel danger, retreat immediately.
Prioritize your own safety over sacrificing yourself to save others.
"Yes, Lady Rana, I will definitely return safely."
I bowed my head again. Lady Rana looked worried, but she trusted me and sent me off.
Freina, let's send support from the Fourth Knight Order as well.
The battle against the dragon zombie may be more intense than we imagine.
Please organize a support unit and entrust the village's defense to them.
"Understood, Lady Rana. I will immediately organize the Fourth Knight Order and send them to support."
Freina said this and immediately began to move.
"Lord Salt."
"Yes?"
Once we were alone in the office, Lady Rana stood up and approached me.
"Please come back safely. Right now, I need you—no, the Fourth Knight Order needs you."
With that, Lady Rana hugged me.
It was the closest we had ever been, and even though it would be understandable for her to feel fear, she trembled slightly, trying to convey her worry.
"Thank you. I will definitely return to you."
"That's a promise. I hold you dear."
"Yes! I also hold you dear, Lady Rana."
I was enveloped by Lady Rana's soft body and her sweet feminine scent, and I made a promise with her.
"I'm off now."
"Yes. Take care, Lord Salt."
I thought it was a short time.
Yet, the time I spent with Lady Rana gave me a definite warmth and made me determined to return without fail.
After parting with Lady Rana, I decided to prepare to set out again with Krush.
This time, the three of us—Krush, May, and I—would head to the northern mountains.
The members of the Fourth Knight Order would also accompany us to support the village.
"Let's go, Krush, May. Stay focused."
"Yes, Lord Salt!"
"Understood, Salt-san!"
The three of us set out once more towards the northern mountains.
On the way to the northern mountains, we visited the surrounding villages again.
Many villagers complained of poor health due to the miasma, and we needed to hurry to the dragon zombie to prevent further damage.
"Lord Salt, the Fourth Knight Order will protect the village, so please focus on your investigation."
The support team from the knight order dispatched by Freina had arrived at the village and was preparing to protect the villagers.
"That helps a lot, thank you."
"Big brother! Big sister!"
Those sisters welcomed us.
After losing their parents, they stayed in the village, raised by the villagers, and seeing them in good spirits reassured me.
I don't know what path they will choose for their future, but I want to support them as much as I can.
"I promise you both that I will ensure your village becomes peaceful and safe, so wait for me."
"Thank you! Big brother Salt!"
The girl who had cried out for help now called me big brother.
She even went to hug Krush, showing her cute side.
After being seen off by the sisters, we finally advanced towards the mountain where the dragon zombie awaited us.
Climbing the steep mountain path, we faced the dangers that awaited us at the summit, where the miasma lingered.
The request was to defeat the dragon zombie.
According to Lina Castor, the vice guild master of the Adventurers Guild, the dragon's corpse left abandoned in the nearby mountains had been contaminated by the miasma and awakened as a zombie.
It’s only natural that if a dragon's corpse is left in the miasma-increasing Corias Territory, a dragon zombie would emerge.
This could further strengthen the miasma and worsen the surrounding environment.
We have already received reports that small monsters have begun to gather.
There was a tension in Lina's voice, conveying the seriousness of the situation.
It’s in the northern mountainous area.
There’s a possibility that surrounding villages could also be affected, so please proceed with caution.
Lina spread out a map and pointed to the location where the dragon zombie had been sighted.
"Understood. Leave it to us."
We prepared to set out to defeat the dragon zombie.
May walked at the front, guiding us through the rocky mountains.
She moved lightly, climbing without making the rocky terrain seem burdensome.
She explained that she usually worked in a department responsible for reconnaissance and investigation, so her nimble movements were often used for hiding during investigations.
"I want to confirm something, but Krush is No Attribute, and May is Wind Attribute, right?"
Everyone born in this world possesses one Attribute.
Whether a warrior or a mage, they can only use magic corresponding to their Attribute.
I am a Holy Attribute thief.
I excel in Holy Attribute healing and purification magic, and I can only activate Holy Attribute attack magic.
"Yes! I am Wind Attribute."
"Wind, huh? That's convenient."
However, May glanced at Krush, seeming to be considerate.
"I... think you already know, but I'm No Attribute."
"Ah, No Attribute is rare."
Hearing for the first time from Krush that she was No Attribute, I recalled an adventurer I knew who had helped me when I first started adventuring and took pride in being No Attribute.
"What can No Attribute Krush do?"
"Wha—! Salt-san, that's not how you say it!"
"May, it's fine. Lord Salt, I can't do anything. I can't use magic."
At my words, May expressed anger, while Krush showed a resigned expression.
"No Attribute means I have no Attribute. I believe that is true."
Krush looked troubled. However, I tilted my head. I felt that my understanding of No Attribute was different from hers.
I finally understood why I had felt a sense of discomfort since coming to the Fourth Knight Order.
There was a discrepancy between my thoughts and theirs.
"That's not right."
"Not right?"
Krush tilted her head, not understanding the intent behind my words.
"Yeah, Attributes have meaning. I believe No Attribute is an Attribute full of possibilities."
Recalling what I had heard about the essence of No Attribute from an old friend, I began to think that Krush might not be aware of its essence.
That's not true.
In reality, I can't use the magic that others can.
My magic power reacts, but nothing happens.
That's why I live by the sword.
With that, she drew her sword from her waist.
"I don't care about it anymore. I don't need an Attribute. With this sword, I will cut down any monster or magic."
I admire Krush's determination, but is that really the case?
No Attribute can use magic.
The No Attribute I know is unaffected by anything and is not swayed by anything.
In fact, each Attribute has its strengths and weaknesses against opposing Attributes.
As a Holy Attribute, I don't exert much power against many Attributes, but I am like a natural enemy to the death Attribute.
Conversely, the death Attribute can exert strong power against many Attributes but struggles against the Holy Attribute.
Since Holy Attribute attack magic is weaker than other Attributes, it often isn't very effective.
That's why, even if it's called a degraded version of healing magic, it is more in demand as a healing role.
Holy Attribute isn't very useful in combat.
Purification magic, like Clean, which removes diseases and dirt, is highly valued, so I once thought about working as a laundry worker if I didn't become an adventurer.
When entering a dungeon for several days, using Clean allows me to keep my body clean, removing odors and such.
Krush seems to be pessimistic about being No Attribute, but Holy Attribute is often treated as a burden when operating in places without miasma.
Right now, it seems that Krush is clinging to her sword not out of pride but because it is the only thing she has.
"Lord Salt, I originally came from the slums."
"The slums?"
When I was young, Lady Rana picked me up, and Lady Freina raised me like a sister.
I think I mentioned before that I don't know my parents.
I wanted to repay those two, but I have limits because I'm No Attribute.
When I visited Corias Territory about a year after I became an adventurer, it was a peaceful place.
There were no slums.
Every town has disparities and hidden aspects.
Even in the Royal Capital, it doesn't change, but Corias was calm and peaceful.
Until Lady Rana became the acting lord, the disparities only continued to widen.
It was through Lady Rana's reforms as the house steward that the town was reborn.
